evd_title: OpenReviewer average recommendation was 5.4 matching human reviewers while GPT-4o averaged 7.7 on 400 NeurIPS and ICLR papers
finding: OpenReviewer average recommendation was 5.4 matching human reviewers while GPT-4o averaged 7.7 on 400 NeurIPS and ICLR papers
P: 400 held-out NeurIPS 2024 + ICLR 2025 papers with OpenReview reviews
I: OpenReviewer (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct full fine-tuned on ~79K reviews); greedy decoding, same prompts
O: Mean recommendation (1-10): OpenReviewer 5.4 +/- 1.1 = humans 5.4 +/- 1.2; GPT-4o 7.7, Claude 7.6, Llama-8B 8.1
T: NeurIPS 2024 + ICLR 2025 test papers; training ICLR/NeurIPS 2022 onward; paper 2025
